answer: A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jetty counter is kept in onyx and sable exposes each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1549 identities would post 952 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
